source_evidence: User exact 'ok continue We do the same thing' authorizes renew V's existing Ready main thrown Psychic Blade on a peryton entering melee with ally, maintain defensive formation, no unchosen V limited resource use. User's previous clarification psychic damage is inherent Soulknife 2020 standard, not homebrew; no piercing conversion; record that prior misleading homebrew description retracted, retain effective Ready ruling from preceding accepted discussion without broader rules change. Standing V dice delegation until stop. Continue from latest accepted R3 packet (historical earlier initiative/R1/R2 roll claims remain unverified; do not reroll or overwrite accepted checkpoint on this continuation). All dice this response actually executed Python secrets.randbelow+1. Initiative V14 Cirren12 perytons5 Fenar4 Mara2. V R3 renews Ready thrown main blade, action spent, no BA or limited expenditure; Cirren renews Ready Toll the Dead on first creature entering melee with party, no slot, concentration while readied. P1 wounded10/33 independently retreats using Dash away/up from party, no attack (now >120ft away, leaves immediate battlefield, not dead). P2 33/33 climbs from z8 to z35, descends 30ft straight to z5 over V, within60ft total movement; Cirren's reaction triggers when within V melee: Wisdom save actual d20 FACE12+1=13 vs DC16 FAIL, healthy target 2d8 FACES1,5=6 necrotic, P2 HP33→27. Cirren concentration ends. V trigger only enemy in melee with ally, not self; P2's approach directly over V is not within5ft of Cirren/Fenar. P2 dives >=30ft and uses Multiattack: Gore d20 FACE15+5=20 vsAC19 HIT, base d8 FACE7+3 plus Dive Attack 2d8 FACES5,3=18 piercing, V48→30. Talons d20 FACE14+5=19 HIT, 2d4 FACES3,2+3 plus Dive 2d8 FACES6,7=21 piercing, V30→9. P2 uses remaining 3ft Flyby ascent to z8, no OAs. P3 independently approaches Cirren, climbs from approx23ft to35ft altitude over x15,y5, then descends straight35ft to ground adjacent to both Cirren and Fenar, approx48ft total. V readied Psychic Blade triggers with ally within5ft, no disadvantage, thrown normal range60ft, d20 FACE4+9=13 vsAC13 HIT; base d6 FACE6+DEX4 and Sneak Attack2d6 FACES2,4=16 psychic (unresisted), P3 HP33→17. Fenar R2 readied magical claw also triggers, actual d20 FACE1 natural miss. No Reckless off-turn. P3 Gore d20 FACE20 natural CRIT against Cirren AC18, base crit 2d8 FACES8,4 plus crit dive4d8 FACES8,2,4,5+STR3=34 piercing, Cirren51→17. Talons d20 FACE18+5=23 HIT; base2d4 FACES1,3+3 plus dive2d8 FACES2,8=17 piercing, Cirren17→0 unconscious dying, no excess instant death or death save failures. P3 ascends ~12ft remaining Flyby, no OAs. On Fenar R3 she recognizes Cirren's collapse and prioritizes stabilizing rather than Readying; moves adjacent to Cirren, Medicine WIS+2 untrained (DC10) actual d20 FACE9+2=11 SUCCESS, Cirren stable unconscious at0HP no death saves necessary while stable, no HP healing or slot. Fenar R3 reaction refreshed, no Ready action now; Rage3/4 active, Shift2/3 active, HP46/59 +6THP, MP6/6. Mara remains inside coach sheltered; 4 horses and coach unharmed. Round4 V next, HP9/48 AC19, all limited features still full, action BA move reaction available. Cirren0/51 stable unconscious, no concentration, spell slots4/3/3 full CD2/2, no active Ready. P2 27/33 AC13 z8 over V (10,-5); P3 17/33 AC13 z12 near (15,5); P1 10/33 fleeing out of immediate battlefield. No other attacks or spend. LongRest0/6, Day308~10:20, purse391gp9sp6cp food21/feed28 PixieDust1, custody and route unchanged. V chooses R4 response, no automatic Second Wind or further combat.
